scope: JFK yellow taxi pickup records 2025-01 through 2025-12
source: NYC TLC monthly yellow taxi trip records; PULocationID=132
history_three_week: Reference baseline only, NOT a model feature. Prior 1,2,3 same weekdays, same target window, rounded to integer; blank before Jan 22. Earlier observed test dates can serve as history.
target: Counts JFK pickups in (t+10min,t+40min], excluding next-day midnight, same as prior demo
prediction_schedule: Daily at one-minute intervals from 06:00 to 23:20 inclusive; New York local time
important: Test set must not be used for fitting, tuning, early stopping, or choosing model features.
Adjacent windows overlap heavily; rows are not independent.
Historical averages depend on actual pickups being observed, not only a fixed static forecast.
January and February etc extracted separately from raw monthly files with out-of-month rows excluded.
No weather or flight features; not observed passenger arrival or waiting; no guarantee of realtime availability.
